sqliteSql: WITH a AS (SELECT department_id,account_id,SUM(expense_cents) AS actual FROM expense_mini GROUP BY department_id,account_id) SELECT b.department_id,b.account_id,COALESCE(a.actual,0)-b.budget_cents AS variance FROM budget_mini b LEFT JOIN a ON b.department_id=a.department_id AND b.account_id=a.account_id ORDER BY b.department_id,b.account_id
